title: Must do
text: Our tour guide Jugo was very good. Extremely knowledgeable of Barcelona area. I would highly recommend him. He explained the history of Spain/Barcelona very well.

title: Wonderful tour of Barcelona!

author: Milla_V

title: If you like historic legends and stories, this is the tour for you!
text: We loved hearing the legends & stories of the old city.  From Roman, Medieval, Christian, Jewish through today... every step has history that provides our steps of today.  Julia was a great guide!
author: Colleen_C

title: Barcelona Walking Tour
text: Our guide Gabriela was spectacular and very knowledgeable of the many sights and history of Barcelona. Her great personality and sense of humor made for a very memorable and interesting day. She was very professional and amazingly talented in navigating the city while educating us about so much history and folklore as well as legends that provoke curiosity.
author: Andrew_G

title: Great Tour
text: We loved our half day tour with Gabi. She made the history of old Barcelona interesting and understandable. The architecture was beyond words and we loved every minute of this tour.
author: Jill_G

title: An Incredible Gaudí Experience!
text: We recently did the walking tour with Ramon through the streets of Barcelona. We had a fantastic time - Ramon was incredibly knowledgeable, energetic, and entertaining. He clearly has a passion for architecture and Gaudí and it was amazing to view the city through his eyes for 4.5 hours. I will say - definitely wear comfortable shoes! We walked between all the sights and had beautiful weather, which made our experience even better. I highly recommend this excursion to anyone looking to explore the city and the architectural beauty!
author: AllisonYYZ

title: Modern and ancient city
text:
Pleasant guide!
Covered a lot of sites and gave historical backgrounds, easy entries. We saw modern and ancient city.
author: irisazweifler

title: Great guide, great intro to Barcelona and Gaudi
text: Jorge was a terrific guide. Made Barcelona come alive, the history, and especially fed my interest in Gaudi. Highly recommend Jorge and this tour.
author: billandlola

title: Excellent Walking Tour of Barcelona
text: Our guide, Jorge, was extremely knowledgeable about the various kinds of architecture that define the Eixample and Barri Gotic neighborhoods.  He was able to point out details in many of the buildings by Gaudi and others that we would have missed had he not been with us.  Additionally, he was a very patient Spanish teacher as we were also working on our Spanish speaking skills.  We cannot say enough good things about him and the value we felt we received by taking this tour.
author: Cruiser13153033106
